## Project 2 Interim Data Analysis Plan

### Requirements
1. For each aim, the hypotheses you will be testing, including a description of the outcome(s) and predictor(s) of interest

2. The over-all analysis approach you will be using for each hypothesis

3. How you will approach/incorporate the other data/variables available besides the outcomes and predictors of interest

4. What power/sample size calculations you will conduct for each of the hypotheses of interest

5. Not required for interim, but will be required for final: thoughts on your approach to type I error control.

### Aim 1

We hypothesize that higher levels of inflammation at baseline, as indicated by cytokine and chemokine levels in circulating plasma, will predict declines in memory consolidation and decreases in AD-signature cortical thickness. Furthermore, greater increases in cytokines and chemokines will be associated with greater declines in episodic memory and cortical thickness. We will evaluate this using general linear models for cytokine and chemokine levels at baseline along with the change in levels between year 0 and year 1 with the decline in memory and cortical thickness as outcomes, while controlling for age, sex, cardiovascular risk, immunological health conditions, APOE genotype, clinical dementia rating, and geriatric depression measure. The measured cytokines and chemokines MCP-1, Eotaxin-1, IL-6, and TNF-alpha will be included in the models. A separate model will be run for each measure of memory decline: a list learning measure, figure recall, the mnemonic similarity task, and long term consolidation.





### Aim 2
We will test our hypothesis of an interaction between peripheral levels of inflammation and amyloid deposition,
such that the presence of both significant amyloid deposition and elevated peripheral inflammatory markers will
be the strongest predictors of memory decline and decline in AD-signature cortical thickness over a one year
period.

## Aim 1 Notes

Based on current clinic flow and participant study consents, we can expect to recruit two to three participants per week; considering the projected 10% attrition over the follow-up period, we plan to recruit 138 aMCI and 56 HC to reach our two-time point goal of 125 aMCI and 50 HC subjects (ages 60–90 years)
